pages.title: Privacy Policy for EnumclawEvents.org
pages.html:
Last updated: July 5, 2025

1. Introduction
EnumclawEvents.org (“we,” “our,” or “us”) operates an online event listing service focused on events in and around Enumclaw, Washington. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting any personal data you choose to share. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding that information.

2. Information We Collect

2.1 Information You Provide Voluntarily

  • Contact form submissions (name, email address, message)
  • Newsletter sign‑ups (email address)

2.2 Automatically Collected Information

  • Usage data via Google Analytics (IP address, device, browser, pages viewed, referring pages)
  • Cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance site experience

2.3 Third‑Party Event Data

  • We fetch public event details (event name, description, dates/times, location) from Facebook’s Graph API based on geographic queries (Enumclaw area).
  • No personal user data (e.g., attendee lists, personal profiles) is collected or stored from Facebook—only public event metadata.

3. How We Use Information

  • Service Delivery: To display up‑to‑date event listings in the Enumclaw area.
  • Communication: To respond to your inquiries via our contact form or newsletter.
  • Analytics & Improvement: To understand site usage and improve functionality, content, and user experience.
  • Security: To monitor and protect against malicious activity.

4. Data Storage & Retention

  • Contact Data: Retained until you request deletion or unsubscribe.
  • Analytics Data: Aggregated and retained per our analytics provider’s policy.
  • Event Data: Cached for up to one hour in order to optimize performance; refreshed on demand.
  • API Credentials: A Facebook Graph API access token (provided by site administrator) is stored in encrypted form and remains until manually removed.

5. Data Sharing & Disclosure

  • We do not sell or rent personal data.
  • We share limited data with third‑party service providers for analytics (e.g., Google Analytics) and content delivery (e.g., Facebook API).
  • We may disclose data when required by law or to protect against fraud or legal liability.

6. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

  • We use cookies to remember your settings and improve site performance.
  • You can disable cookies via your browser settings, though some features may not function correctly.

7. Third‑Party Links

Our site may include links to external websites (e.g., event organizer pages). We are not responsible for their privacy practices; please review their own policies.

8. Your Rights

  • Access & Correction: You may request access to or correction of your personal data by contacting us.
  • Deletion: You can request erasure of your personal data at any time.
  • Opt‑Out: You can opt out of marketing communications or disable cookies.

To exercise these rights, email us at privacy@enumclawevents.org.

9. Children’s Privacy

Our service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If you believe we have inadvertently done so, please contact us to request deletion.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy when our practices change. The “Last updated” date at the top will reflect the most recent revision. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the new policy.

11. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact:

Enumclaw Events
Email: privacy@enumclawevents.org
Website: https://enumclawevents.org/privacy-policy/

pages.title: About Us
pages.html:
Our mission is to connect residents and visitors with the diverse array of events that make our town unique.

About EnumclawEvents

EnumclawEvents.org is a locally run events calendar created to make it easier to see what’s happening around Enumclaw, Washington — all in one place.

What started as a simple idea quickly became a community resource. Enumclaw has no shortage of great events, but they’re often scattered across social media, flyers, school newsletters, and individual websites. EnumclawEvents brings those listings together into a single, easy-to-use platform so residents, visitors, and businesses can stay connected to what’s happening in town.

Exposure

Hosting something in Enumclaw? Share your event with the community and get the word out fast.

Stay Up to Date

Stay up to date with all the local happenings—from festivals to farmer’s markets—in one easy-to-browse calendar.

Making an Impact

We shine a light on local organizations, venues, and individuals making an impact through events.

Volunteer Opportunities

Get involved behind the scenes by finding ways to support local events and causes.

Celebrate Local. Connect Community.

posts.title: February Update: What’s New on EnumclawEvents
posts.excerpt: As we head into February, we’ve been making steady improvements to EnumclawEvents with one goal in mind: making it easier to discover what’s happening around town — and where to go when you’re not sure what you’re looking for yet….
posts.html:
As we head into February, we’ve been making steady improvements to EnumclawEvents with one goal in mind: making it easier to discover what’s happening around town — and where to go when you’re not sure what you’re looking for yet.

This update focuses on exploration, usability, and better ways to find the things that matter most to you, whether that’s an event this weekend or a new place to eat.

A New Explore Page and Places to Eat

One of the biggest additions is the new Explore section, designed to go beyond a traditional event calendar. This area brings together food, venues, and local spots into one place so you can browse even when you don’t have a specific plan in mind.

Alongside this, we’ve added a dedicated Places to Eat section that highlights local restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and food trucks around Enumclaw and the plateau. This is a growing directory meant to help answer the simple question we all ask regularly: Where should we go?

You’ll continue to see this section expand over time as more places are added and refined.

Improved Search Capabilities

Finding events and places should be quick and intuitive. Behind the scenes, we’ve been working on improving search so it’s easier to surface relevant results without scrolling endlessly.

Search is now better at understanding what you’re looking for, whether that’s an event type, a venue, or a general keyword. This makes it easier to jump straight to what you need, especially as the calendar continues to grow.

What’s Coming Next

February’s updates are part of a larger effort to make EnumclawEvents more than just a list of events. The focus moving forward will continue to be on discovery, clarity, and supporting local venues and organizers in a way that feels natural and useful for the community.

If you notice something that could work better, or if there’s a feature you’d love to see, feedback is always welcome. This platform is evolving alongside the community it serves.

Thanks for being here — and for supporting local events, places, and people.

posts.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
posts.excerpt: EnumclawEvents.org Introduces Eddie the Yeti as New Community Mascot Enumclaw, WA — 12/6/25 — EnumclawEvents.org is excited to announce the arrival of Eddie the Yeti, a friendly mountain-dwelling mascot who will serve as the official guide to local happenings, community…
posts.html:
EnumclawEvents.org Introduces Eddie the Yeti as New Community Mascot

Enumclaw, WA — 12/6/25 — EnumclawEvents.org is excited to announce the arrival of Eddie the Yeti, a friendly mountain-dwelling mascot who will serve as the official guide to local happenings, community stories, and events throughout the Plateau.

Eddie, who “lives” near Crystal Mountain, has been quietly exploring Enumclaw and taking an interest in the people, places, and traditions that make the region special. Now, he’s stepping into the spotlight to help residents and visitors stay connected with everything happening around town.
“Eddie brings a fun, welcoming personality to EnumclawEvents.org,” said the EnumclawEvents team. “He represents the spirit of our region—outdoor adventure, community pride, and a genuine love for gathering together.”

Beginning in January, Eddie will appear across the EnumclawEvents.org website, newsletters, and social media channels. His weekly feature, “Eddie’s Picks,” will highlight standout events, seasonal activities, and must-see happenings curated by Eddie himself.

“I’ve explored snowy peaks, forest trails, and now the streets of Enumclaw,” Eddie said in his first public message. “There’s so much happening here, and I can’t wait to share my favorite finds with everyone!”

Eddie’s role will include:

  • Spotlighting top local events each week
  • Sharing insights, announcements, and community stories
  • Bringing a playful, memorable character to Enumclaw’s event scene
  • Helping more residents discover what’s happening in their own backyard

EnumclawEvents.org continues to grow as a central hub for local events, partnering organizations, and community engagement. Eddie’s addition marks another step forward in making the platform both informative and enjoyable.

For more information and to see Eddie’s weekly picks, visit EnumclawEvents.org.

About EnumclawEvents.org

EnumclawEvents.org is a community-driven platform dedicated to showcasing events, activities, and local businesses throughout the Enumclaw Plateau. The site aims to support connection, visibility, and participation across the region through accurate event listings, creative storytelling, and partnerships with local organizations.

posts.title: December Update: Growth, Wins, and New Features for the Community
posts.excerpt: As we close out the year, I wanted to share a quick update on what’s been happening with Enumclaw Events—and there’s a lot to celebrate! Website Traffic Continues to Climb December has been our strongest month yet.We saw 31,000 impressions…
posts.html:
As we close out the year, I wanted to share a quick update on what’s been happening with Enumclaw Events—and there’s a lot to celebrate!

Website Traffic Continues to Climb

December has been our strongest month yet.
We saw 31,000 impressions and 3,500 unique users visiting the site to discover what’s happening around Enumclaw. That’s a huge step forward in making local events easier for everyone to find.

This growth tells us something important: people are using and relying on Enumclaw Events more than ever. Thank you for being part of it.

Holiday Fantasy Video Success

One of the highlights of the month was the Holiday Fantasy video.
The community loved it—shares, comments, and conversations across social media helped it reach far more people than expected. It’s been a fun and special way to showcase Enumclaw’s holiday spirit, and it brought a lot of new eyes to local events.

New Website Improvements

Your feedback is shaping the platform, and this month we rolled out several upgrades to make event browsing smoother and more interactive:

  • “Going” and “Interested” Buttons
    You can now mark whether you’re going or interested in an event. This helps organizers understand engagement and gives visitors a better sense of what’s popular.
  • Performance & UI Enhancements
    Several behind-the-scenes improvements were made to help pages load faster and look cleaner across devices.

These features are just the beginning—more are on the way to make discovering local events even easier.

Thank You

Whether you’re an event organizer, a local business, or someone who loves staying plugged into the community, thank you for supporting Enumclaw Events.
Let’s keep building something great together in the new year.

posts.excerpt: Happy November, Enumclaw. Three quick wins to share before we dive into site updates. Monthly traffic milestoneEnumclawEvents is now surpassing 1,000 unique visitors each month. Thank you for reading, sharing, and submitting your events. This growth helps more neighbors discover…
posts.html:
Happy November, Enumclaw. Three quick wins to share before we dive into site updates.

Monthly traffic milestone
EnumclawEvents is now surpassing 1,000 unique visitors each month. Thank you for reading, sharing, and submitting your events. This growth helps more neighbors discover what is happening around town.

Holiday Fantasy sponsor
We are proud to be a sponsor for the Holiday Fantasy Event. Expect clear listings, helpful reminders, and photo coverage opportunities as we get closer to the big weekend.

First pop up photo booth
Our first pop up photo booth debuted on Halloween, and it was a blast. Thank you to everyone who stopped by, scanned the code, and grabbed their photos. We are planning more seasonal photo spots, so keep an eye on announcements.

Site improvements

  • School events hub, now easier to browse, with more concerts, games, and fundraisers in one place.
  • Photo services available to book, including event coverage, headshots, product sessions, and social content bundles.
  • Faster event submissions, with a shorter form and smarter defaults.
  • Better search and performance, with quicker category pages and improved partial word matching.
  • Seasonal galleries rolling out, with download options when organizers allow it.

What is next

Automated imports from key local sources, a cleaner organizer dashboard, and sponsor placements that highlight useful services without clutter. If you manage events, send us your calendar feed. If you want photo coverage with a featured listing, ask about a bundle.

Thanks for helping build a simple, reliable place to find local events. Tell a friend, submit an event, and we will keep moving forward together.

posts.title: October: School Hub & Photo Launch
posts.excerpt: Fall is here, and with it a big milestone for our community hub. We’re excited to share that EnumclawEvents has partnered with the Enumclaw School District to make it easier for families to find school happenings in one place. From…
posts.html:
Fall is here, and with it a big milestone for our community hub. We’re excited to share that EnumclawEvents has partnered with the Enumclaw School District to make it easier for families to find school happenings in one place. From concerts and games to parent nights and fundraisers, we’re centralizing district event info so you don’t have to dig through multiple flyers and calendars. This is a step toward our vision: one trusted, local source for what’s happening across the Plateau.

We’ve also launched products for photography services—built for local businesses, nonprofits, and families who want high-quality visuals without the runaround. Whether you need event coverage, team headshots, product photos, or social content, you can now book directly through our site with clear packages and transparent pricing. These services help fund the platform while giving you creative assets that actually get used (and loved) across your website and social channels.

Enumclaw School District + EnumclawEvents: What it means

  • A growing, easy-to-browse collection of district and school events in one hub.
  • Better visibility for performances, athletics, club activities, and parent/teacher events.
  • Fewer missed dates—families can check the weekend lineup and plan fast.

If you’re an ESD organizer or coach, you can share your events and calendar details so we can keep everything current. If you’re a parent, bookmark the school events page and check back often—new items are added continually.

Photography Services: Now Live

  • Event photography for fundraisers, galas, and community nights
  • Business & brand sessions (headshots, teams, location shoots)
  • Product & food photography for local shops and restaurants
  • Social content bundles tailored to the posts you’ll actually publish

Each package includes straightforward deliverables and a simple booking flow. If you have a unique need (district programs, seasonal campaigns, holiday events), reach out—custom quotes are welcome.

What’s next

  • Continued improvements to our school event hub and browsing experience
  • Streamlined event submissions (shorter forms, smarter defaults)
  • Ongoing work on automated imports from key local sources to reduce manual entry
  • New sponsorship and featured placement options that highlight community-minded businesses and nonprofits

How you can help this month

  • Submit your events (school, nonprofit, business—everyone’s welcome).
  • Share your calendar feeds if you manage a page with recurring events.
  • Book a photo package if you’re prepping for a fall launch, fundraiser, or holiday campaign.
  • Spread the word—tell a neighbor, a coach, or a PTA lead about EnumclawEvents.

Thanks for being part of this community project. The goal is simple: make it effortless to discover local happenings and support the people who make Enumclaw special.

— The EnumclawEvents Team

posts.title: EnumclawEvents Partners with the Enumclaw School District
posts.excerpt: We are excited to announce a new partnership between EnumclawEvents.org and the Enumclaw School District! This collaboration marks an important step forward in our mission to connect the community through a central hub of local happenings. By partnering with the…
posts.html:
We are excited to announce a new partnership between EnumclawEvents.org and the Enumclaw School District! This collaboration marks an important step forward in our mission to connect the community through a central hub of local happenings.

By partnering with the school district, EnumclawEvents will provide increased visibility for district events, ensuring that families, students, and community members never miss out on opportunities to get involved, support, and celebrate what’s happening in our schools. From concerts and performances to sports, fundraisers, and special programs, you’ll now be able to find district events listed right alongside other community activities.

This partnership also brings additional legitimacy and recognition to EnumclawEvents as a trusted community platform. By working directly with local institutions like the Enumclaw School District, we’re strengthening our role as a reliable source for discovering what’s happening in Enumclaw — making it easier than ever for residents to stay connected.

We look forward to highlighting upcoming school events and continuing to grow EnumclawEvents as a true reflection of the community we serve.

This month we launched three features designed to help our local economy and community thrive: a dedicated Vendors directory, a new Venues showcase, and a one-stop Get Involved page. Whether you’re a small business, an event host, or someone who wants to volunteer, these tools make it easier than ever to connect, promote, and join community life.

Vendors — showcase your small business

Local makers, food vendors, shops, and service providers can now create a profile that puts them directly where visitors look for events and services.

Why list as a Vendor?

  • Be discoverable by people searching event pages and vendor directories.
  • Feature your products, hours, contact info and booking links.
  • Get promoted in relevant event pages (markets, fairs, festivals).

Quick steps to join

  1. Visit /vendors and fill out the application form
  2. Fill out basic business info, sent us logo and photos
  3. We review and publish — then you’re visible to thousands of local event-goers

Venues — make your space the go-to spot for gatherings

From banquet halls to breweries and community greens, venues are a key part of Enumclaw’s events ecosystem. The new Venues page lets venue owners showcase their spaces — and helps organizers find the right space quickly.

How Venues help the community

  • Easier booking for event organizers — less back-and-forth.
  • Better exposure to local groups, businesses, and residents.
  • Built-in call-to-action for bookings or inquiries so leads find you fast.

How to list a venue

  1. Go to /venues and fill out the application form
  2. Provide venue details (capacity, features, rental terms) and images
  3. We review and publish

Get Involved — volunteer, donate, partner, or sponsor

Want to do more than attend events? Our new Get Involved page collects all the ways neighbors and organizations can support Enumclaw’s community life — from volunteering at clean-ups and markets to sponsoring local initiatives.

What you’ll find there

  • Volunteer opportunities and signup links.
  • How to donate or partner with the site and local nonprofits.
  • A simple contact form to suggest an idea or ask how you can help.

Visit /get-involved to see current openings and partnership options.

A few examples of how this helps

  • A local baker signs up as a Vendor and gets booked at three markets over the fall.
  • A small venue lists availability, and an organizer finds the perfect space for a community fundraiser the next weekend.
  • Volunteers sign up through Get Involved and help make a neighborhood cleanup a success.

Questions? We’re here to help

If you’re a vendor, venue owner, or group organizer and want help creating your listing, email us at info@enumclawevents.org. We’re happy to walk you through it and share tips for making your listing stand out.

posts.html:
Big month! We’ve shipped a handful of upgrades to make it faster to find, save, and share what’s happening around the Plateau. Here’s what’s new.

1) Weekly Newsletter (free!)

Never miss a weekend again. Get a quick, curated list of upcoming events in your inbox.

What you’ll get:

  • Top picks for the weekend
  • Family-friendly highlights
  • New and notable events added this week

2) Trending Events (based on views)

See what’s buzzing right now. The Trending section surfaces events that are getting the most attention on the site (by recent view count), so you can jump straight to what the community is checking out.

Pro tip: Love an event? Like it and share it—more engagement helps it get seen by more neighbors.

3) Popular Events on the Home Page

We added a Popular Events grid to the homepage so you can quickly scan what lots of folks are looking at. It’s a handy “start here” if you’re just browsing.

Quick tips

  • Add to Calendar: Don’t miss it—save any event to your calendar from the event page.
  • Like & Share: Click Like and Share to boost visibility and help great events trend.
  • Search smarter: Use category/date filters to zero in on exactly what you’re after.

For organizers

  • High-quality landscape images look best in cards and on social.
  • Include a clear ticket or “learn more” link—events with links get more clicks.
  • Posting early = more time to get featured in the newsletter and trend on the site.

Have feedback or a feature request? We’re listening. Thanks for being part of Enumclaw’s event community—the mountain starts here.
